summary: Order mixed-source conversations by timestamp and preserve independent replay positions

replay.detail: Native and graph source counters remain independent. Replay selects graph changes by exact projected entry identity and reports cursor-gap when a bounded window cannot cover changes since the supplied cursor.

schema.detail: No schema changes. Original source counters, timestamps and entry identities are preserved.

compatibility.detail: Mixed timeline entries sort by numeric RFC3339 instant, source sequence and stable identity instead of comparing unrelated counters. Existing incremental folds, frozen pagination and built-page delta placement are retained.

manual.detail: Clients receiving cursor-gap reload the authoritative conversation window as before.

recovery.detail: No source history is rewritten or removed.
